title: ExperienceRecord
description: One unit of experience produced by a rollout/eval worker for the learning loop: what was run, under EXACTLY which policy and model version, with what outcome, receipt-backed, and where the payload lives. Staleness-attribution invariant: policyDigest is mandatory — in a distributed trainer/rollout topology workers read policy from a store while the trainer updates it, so every experience must pin the digest it was generated under or the trainer consumes unattributable data. Storage tiers are a closed named set (durable, hot) with stated semantics; an open 'Others' backend list hides ordering/durability divergence and is deliberately excluded.

specVersion.description: Epistemic-kernel contract version, pinned. Changing this const is a contract change.

loopRef.description: ControlLoop URN when this experience was produced inside a learning loop; omitted for standalone board/eval runs.

generatorRef.description: URN or stable reference of the rollout worker, eval runner, or board arm that generated this experience.

policyDigest.description: Digest of the exact policy version the generator was executing under. Mandatory — the staleness-attribution invariant.

modelDigest.description: Digest of the model artifact in use, when the generator ran a model distinct from the policy.

runRef.description: URN of the run this experience belongs to (e.g. a ReasoningRun or RunRecord).

envRef.description: URN or stable reference of the environment/dataset/subject the generator interacted with.

tier.description: Named storage tier with stated semantics: durable = ordered, persistent, replayable (object store); hot = low-latency, evictable, non-authoritative cache. Closed set at v0.1.

uri.description: Locator of the experience payload within the tier.

payloadHash.description: Content digest of the payload, so a hot-tier copy is verifiable against the durable one.

payload.description: Pointer to the experience payload. The record itself stays small; bulk data lives in the tiered store.

receiptRef.description: URN of the sealed receipt covering the generation of this experience.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time the experience was generated.

idempotencyKey.description: Replay guard so re-delivered experiences never double-count in training or on the board.
